reels.title: TIDES: Implicit Time-Awareness in Selective State Space Models

editorial_notes.reasoning: This paper addresses a core bottleneck in state-of-the-art models (Mamba/SSMs). It fits perfectly into 'hardware_efficiency' and allows for beautiful 3b1b-style animations showing the distortion of time-steps in latent space.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: Why does your AI 'forget' the passage of time, and how can we fix the 'time-warp' inside its brain?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A metronome that keeps speeding up or slowing down without the listener knowing, causing the music to lose its rhythm.
